$comment: Published CPMM parameters for the Stonkz bonding curve. Consumed by apps/api (quote), apps/web (Step-3 launch preview) and both on-chain programs. Every number here is an exact rational — do not round these before feeding them to integer math.

tokensForSale.note: 80% of fixed supply is sellable on the curve

lpReserve.note: 20% of fixed supply is escrowed for the graduation pool

virtualBaseReserves0.note: Ceil, not floor: graduation mcap is 15*VB0, so rounding up keeps the close at or fractionally above $69K rather than fractionally below.

gradMcapBaseAtoms.note: Snapshotted once at create_token from a fresh oracle read. The curve is base-denominated from then on.

feeSplitBps.note: protocol and ops are floor(fee*bps/10000); the creator bucket takes fee - protocol - ops so the three always sum to the fee exactly. Dust (<= 2 atoms) lands in the creator bucket.

creatorBucketSplit.stakersFormula: floor(creatorBucket * eligibleStaked / (2 * circulating)), clamped to floor(creatorBucket / 2)

lockWeightsBps.note: FLEX (0 days) is escrow-only and earns zero pool weight in v1 (anti-wash). The UI's LOCKS table shows 1x for FLEX; that is display chrome, not pool weight.

cashback.note: On-chain granularity is whole seconds (Solana Clock / EVM block.timestamp). Clients must floor cbLeft to seconds before mirroring this.
